verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships a separate open-source Python library for running the agent locally from your own code with any LLM, and the docs explicitly point users there for a local agent. A community user confirms running it locally against their own browser profile. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license and self-hosting/deployment guide in the evidence, and self-hostable equivalents of cloud-only features (stealth Chromium fork, CAPTCHA solving, residential proxies, profiles/sessions API).
